decisions.reason: Because the product is close to the firm's established fluid-handling offer and the firm's own R&D provides the related knowledge to interpret early results and improve it, the firm is likely to keep it.
Building on the firm's existing filtration knowledge, the firm can assimilate and refine the hydrocyclone filter using its absorptive capacity and R&D, so dropping is unlikely.
As a coolant filter close to the firm's core filtration expertise, the firm can apply its related knowledge to learn from results and improve the product, making it likely to stay on the market.
